title: Every Tree GLOWS When You Tell a Secret… Even DAD'S 🌳✨
description:
In this town, when you WHISPER a true secret to a tree, the tree GLOWS! Dad's oak goes neon orange, Ms Patel's maple flickers pink… and Mrs Gomez's hidden garden is about to be bulldozed at sunrise. Rudy has one night to find the gate, and only a TRUE secret will light the way. But Tim is racing him… and Tim has a secret of his own. 🌳✨

A short, kid-friendly story about telling the truth, being brave, and sharing what you've got.

#shorts #animation #kidsstory #storytime #funny
